description: This file implements a Koala noise suppression audio filter for the Pipecat project, utilizing PicoVoice's Koala engine to reduce background noise in audio streams. It defines the KoalaFilter class with methods for initialization, starting, stopping, processing control frames, and filtering audio data.

classes.name: KoalaFilter
classes.description: A class that provides real-time noise suppression for audio streams using PicoVoice's Koala engine. It buffers audio data, manages engine state, and applies noise suppression in chunks.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the KoalaFilter with an access key for PicoVoice's engine.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Sets up the filter with the input sample rate and checks compatibility with Koala's required sample rate.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Resets the Koala engine when stopping the filter.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes control frames to enable or disable filtering.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Applies noise suppression to incoming audio bytes, buffering and processing in chunks matching Koala's frame length.
